text:
Build a complete, attractive browser-based Snake game in this project. I want a modern, polished interface with a clear board, readable score and best score, a start/restart flow, pause/resume, visible instructions, keyboard controls (arrows and WASD), and usable touch controls on mobile. The game must genuinely work: growth on food, food on free cells, correct self/wall collisions, no instant reversal into the snake, and reliable reset. Best score should persist locally. It should feel good on desktop and a narrow phone viewport, with accessible buttons and readable contrast.

Keep the project lightweight and offline: plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript, no external services or dependency downloads. Add meaningful tests using Node's built-in test runner and make npm test run them; the empty starting project passing zero tests is not verification. Provide clear local preview instructions.

Start by making a proportionate plan, using your normal planning/workflow features. Break work into small tasks and delegate independent coding work where your harness supports it; tell me what is actually happening rather than claiming unavailable workers. Keep me involved: ask practical product questions, let me review the plan and progress, and explain any failure. Verify the requested behavior and current project checks before claiming completion. Keep a record of important product/design decisions using your normal project memory features. I will try the game and may request changes before accepting it.
